Raj (HarborWing): hey team — we want to onboard a customer-finetuned reranker for our search stack. needs to live in private (VPC), HSM for keys, and phi redaction. can you intake?
Mia (CS): thanks Raj — noted private + HSM + PHI scope. quick Q: is this a fresh fine-tune you trained or a packaged 3rd-party model?
Raj (HarborWing): fresh fine-tune (internal data). training artifacts include labeled relevance pairs and anonymized PII fields but we need verify redaction. throughput target ~120 qps p95 latency <= 180ms.
Sam (Solutions SE): @Mia assigning me to lead the infra/latency side. 120 qps with 180ms p95 on private deployment -> likely Dedicated capacity (GPU pool). we'll do perf test with replayed traffic.
Alex (ML Eng): For safety/evals I'll need: (1) holdout eval set with edge cases, (2) prompt set that triggers PII, (3) failure-mode examples. we'll run quality baseline vs our open-model-13B and a quantized variant.
Priya (Security): we'll run a privacy review and HSM keyflow check. Raj pls confirm where datasets will be stored and if you want us to run deterministic tokenization for PHI detection.
Raj (HarborWing): dataset will be S3 in our VPC with encryption. yes want deterministic tokenization and redaction. Also need SOC2 & HIPAA paperwork for our legal/compliance team.
Mia (CS): noted — I'll attach onboarding checklist and SOC2/HIPAA request template. Next steps: 1) send sample eval set (<= 1000 queries) 2) sign AUP + DPA 3) schedule 60m enablement call (ops + security + se)
Sam (Solutions SE): Perf plan snippet: run 3x 10m steady-state replay at target QPS, measure tail (p50/p95/p99), CPU/GPU utilization, and token-emit throughput. example k6 command we use:
```
k6 run --out influxdb script_search_replay.js --vus 120 --duration 10m
```
I'll share config for autoscale and preferred GPU SKU after we ingest sample traffic.
Alex (ML Eng): Safety evals: we'll run precision@k for rerank, mean reciprocal rank (MRR), and an automated PHI-leakage check (token overlap & named-entity detection). If PHI leaks exceed threshold we'll recommend additional preprocessing or differential-privacy style aggregation.
Priya (Security): also creating a Jira security checklist ticket for HSM integration and key rotation policies. we'll need cust-managed KMS ARN and HSM proof-of-possession doc.
Mia (CS): Deploy ticket created — see deploy-bot link below. Raj, can you confirm availability for enablement call tomorrow 11am PT or Thu 2pm PT?
deploy-bot: ticket CS-4821 created and assigned to Mia, Sam, Alex, Priya. link: https://redwood.example/CS-4821
Raj (HarborWing): Thu 2pm PT works. will upload 500-sample eval set to the S3 path and share IAM role. also attaching their legal contact (tara@harborwing.com).
Mia (CS): perfect — I'll send calendar invite and attach the onboarding checklist + legal template. tagging @Sam @Alex @Priya to prep any pre-call items.
Sam (Solutions SE): prepping load script and cost estimate for Dedicated. quick heads up — if latency can't hit 180ms p95 we'll present fallback options (smaller quantized model, aggressive KV caching).
Alex (ML Eng): prepping evaluation harness. Raj — if you can provide a few failure-case annotations that helped during fine-tune that'll speed safety triage.
Mia (CS): capturing this as next steps in the ticket. Renewal note: account shows usage uptick but no Dedicated contract yet — successful onboarding + SLA hit will be key to conversion this quarter. tagging CS manager for renewal playbook. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Raj (HarborWing): thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. we'll be in the call Thu. :thumbsup:
